comment: The ONLY relations client code may address. Shared by scripts/lint_from_allowlist.sh and tests/db/config_drift.test.ts. It also holds `exposedSchemas`, the PostgREST-exposed schema list, read by tests/db/rls_anon_column_containment.test.ts and asserted against supabase/config.toml by tests/db/config_drift.test.ts. Both READ THIS FILE -- config_drift imports it and asserts `mirrors` equals the supabase_realtime publication membership -- so the lint's allowlist and the database's published surface cannot drift apart.
